plugins.name: rhombus-developer
plugins.description: Build on Rhombus. Auto-configures the official rhombus-node-mcp and the Rhombus docs MCP, ships six /rhombus-* commands (find-endpoint, schema, curl, sdk, mcp-status, newproject), API-architect and webhook-debugger agents, and five skills covering API reference, SDK codegen, webhook scaffolding, and edge streaming (RTSP/ONVIF).

plugins.name: rhombus-user
plugins.description: Day-to-day Rhombus tools. CLI reference, deployment context, Rhombus MIND AI, support-article link directory, alert + device + footage-investigator agents, five /rhombus-* workflow commands, CLI auto-install and command-validation hooks.

plugins.name: rhombus-partner
plugins.description: MSP and reseller fleet management. Client-selector, fleet-ops, and onboarding agents, cross-client reporting and onboarding skills, six /rhombus-* multi-org commands (clients, client-switch, audit-clients, client-alerts, client-devices, fleet-report), active-client session state, and partner-aware command validation.
